'''Nick DeKasa''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Fort Collins tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|the new WYS objective]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1712">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territoryd1712/ ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territory], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-07-ft-collins-co-1-27-01-new-territoryd1712/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
